description: Vendored copies of avd-second-brain contracts C15 (fact register) and C20 (the index and method schemas). Each must be byte-identical to the file at brainCommit; tests/check_method.py checks the hashes and validates index.json and method.json against them. To update: copy the files from avd-second-brain at a new commit, then update brainCommit and the hashes in the same PR.
